name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Higher Education (NSP)
description: Financial assistance to students from eligible income backgrounds pursuing post-secondary studies, diplomas, and undergraduate or postgraduate degrees.
benefits: 100% tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance ranging from ₹4,000 to ₹13,500 per annum depending on the degree/course level.
eligibility: Indian citizens enrolled in recognized post-secondary institutions whose total family annual income does not exceed ₹2,50,000.
required_documents: Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
Current Fee Receipt & Bonafide Student Certificate
Active Bank Account Passbook (linked with Aadhaar)
application_steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with Mobile & Aadhaar.
Fill in academic details, institute code, and course particulars.
Upload verified caste/income certificates and institute bonafide.
Submit application for online verification by institute nodal officer.
Track status and receive Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into bank account.

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Technical & Professional Courses
description: Targeted scholarship to support meritorious undergraduate and postgraduate students pursuing technical and professional degree programs.
benefits: Financial support covering maintenance allowance up to ₹1,000 per month and course fee reimbursement up to ₹20,000 per annum.
eligibility: Students pursuing recognized professional/technical courses with at least 50% marks in previous examinations and annual family income up to ₹2,50,000.
required_documents: Income Certificate from authorized Tehsildar / Sub-Divisional Magistrate
Proof of admission in recognized technical/professional institute
application_steps: Visit National Scholarship Portal (NSP) and complete One Time Registration (OTR).
Select Scheme under Central Schemes Ministry of Education section.
Upload verified documents and fee receipts.
Institute verification followed by State Nodal Officer approval.
Disbursement via PFMS (DBT mode).

name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Central sector scheme providing income support to all landholding farmer families across the country for agricultural and domestic needs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year paid in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly deposited into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names. Institutional landholders and high-income taxpayers excluded.
required_documents: Land Ownership Documents (Khatauni / Land record RoR)
application_steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or visit nearest CSC center.
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' and enter Aadhaar and Mobile number.
Enter state, district, sub-district, block, and land registration ID.
Complete OTP-based e-KYC or biometric authentication at Common Service Centre.
State nodal office verifies land records; funds disbursed per installment schedule.

name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: The world's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme offering cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization care.
benefits: Cashless health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across empanelled hospitals nationwide.
eligibility: Families identified by SECC 2011 database criteria and low-income families holding valid ration cards / state health cards. No cap on family size or age.
required_documents: Ration Card or PM-JAY Family ID letter
application_steps: Check eligibility on mera.pmjay.gov.in using Mobile number or Ration card.
Visit any Ayushman Mitra kiosk at nearest government or empanelled private hospital.
Authenticate your identity using Aadhaar e-KYC.
Receive your Ayushman Bharat Golden Card with unique ABHA number.
Present card at empanelled hospital for completely cashless medical treatment.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY – Housing for All)
description: Government initiative ensuring all eligible urban and rural families without a pucca house receive pucca housing with basic amenities.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) or direct financial assistance of ₹1.20 - ₹1.30 lakh for house construction in rural areas.
eligibility: Families with no pucca house in their name anywhere in India, categorized under EWS (income up to ₹3L) or LIG (income up to ₹6L).
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Proof of no existing pucca house ownership affidavit
Land title or allotment letter (if constructing)
application_steps: Log in to pmaymis.gov.in (Urban) or pmayg.nic.in (Gramin) using citizen registration.
Choose appropriate component (CLSS / Beneficiary-led Construction).
Provide household details, existing housing status, and Aadhaar info.
Upload required income and address documents.
Verification by local municipal corporation / Gram Panchayat committee.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: Non-contributory monthly pension scheme providing financial dignity and sustenance to elderly citizens living below the poverty line.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹200 to ₹500 (supplemented by additional state contributions up to ₹1,000 - ₹2,500/month in many states) credited via DBT.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 60 years or above living in households categorized under Below Poverty Line (BPL).
required_documents: BPL Ration Card or BPL Survey list inclusion proof
Aadhaar-linked Bank or Post Office Savings Account Passbook
application_steps: Obtain application form from Block Development Office (BDO) or District Social Welfare Office.
Attach verified age and BPL proofs.
Submit to Gram Panchayat secretary or Urban Local Body officer.
Inspection and sanction by Sub-Divisional Officer (SDO).
Direct pension release every month into bank account.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Comprehensive central scheme offering holistic support to artisans and craftspeople engaged in 18 traditional trades.
benefits: Recognition as Vishwakarma through certificate and ID, skill upgrading with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 modern toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3,00,000 at concessional 5% interest rate.
eligibility: Artisan or craftsperson working on hands-on tools in one of 18 trades (carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, potter, cobbler, tailor, etc.) aged 18+.
required_documents: Trade-specific declaration / verification from Gram Panchayat / ULB
application_steps: Visit Common Service Centre (CSC) or pmvishwakarma.gov.in.
Authenticate with Aadhaar e-KYC and register your traditional trade.
Tier 1 Gram Panchayat / ULB verification of your artisan practice.
Enroll for 5-7 days basic skill training with daily stipend.
Receive digital ID, toolkit grant, and apply for low-interest credit.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Small deposit savings scheme targeted for the welfare, education, and marriage security of the girl child with high government-backed interest.
benefits: Attractive government interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a.), triple tax exemption under Section 80C (EEE status), and secure maturity fund for higher education at age 18.
eligibility: Legal guardian or parents can open account for a girl child from birth up to the age of 10 years. Maximum two accounts per family.
required_documents: Birth Certificate of the girl child
Identity and Address Proof of the parent/guardian (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID)
Passport size photos of child and parent
application_steps: Collect SSY application form from any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.
Fill child details and attach verified birth certificate.
Make initial opening deposit (minimum ₹250).
Receive passbook with account number and track deposits annually.
Partial withdrawal allowed when girl turns 18 for accredited university admission.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed pension scheme for workers in unorganized sectors to secure predictable monthly income during old age.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000 or ₹5,000 from age 60 until life, with corpus returned to nominee upon demise.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years holding a savings bank account. Must not be an income taxpayer.
application_steps: Approach your bank branch or netbanking portal where you maintain a savings account.
Fill the APY subscriber registration form and select target monthly pension amount (₹1,000 - ₹5,000).
Authorize auto-debit of monthly/quarterly premium contribution.
Receive PRAN (Permanent Retirement Account Number) card and SMS confirmation.
Pension commences automatically upon turning 60 years of age.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides collateral-free institutional credit up to ₹10-20 Lakh to micro and small non-farm enterprises for self-employment and business scaling.
benefits: Loans up to ₹50,000 (Shishu), ₹5 Lakh (Kishore), and ₹10 Lakh (Tarun) without collateral at competitive interest rates with nominal processing fee.
eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises including shopkeepers, artisans, small manufacturing units, food service, repair shops.
required_documents: Proof of residence & business establishment address
Business Project Proposal / Quotation for machinery or inventory
Past 6 months bank statement (if existing enterprise)
application_steps: Prepare a simple business plan describing goods/services and funding needed.
Apply online via Udyami Mitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or visit any commercial bank/NBFC.
Submit application under desired tier (Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun).
Bank evaluates proposal and sanctions Mudra debit card for working capital.
Drawdown funds as needed for enterprise purchase.
